what_it_does: Maps a supplied IT-power trace and hourly weather to facility power, PUE, cooling mode, and raw evaporative water. Does not infer IT power from annual totals.
equations: m_air = P_IT×1e6 / (c_p × ΔT_server); t_full = t_db − ε max(t_db−t_wb,0); t_supply = t_db if t_db≤T* else T* if t_full≤T* else t_full; W_evap_kg/s = m_air × max(w_s−w_o,0) at constant moist-air enthalpy; m³/h = kg/s × 3.6; p_fan=0.025 P_IT; p_other=0.035 P_IT; p_evap_aux=0.005 P_IT × spray; P_fac = P_IT+p_fan+p_other+p_evap_aux; PUE=P_fac/P_IT.
inputs: weather_hourly.csv (t_db, t_wb, rh, pressure); P_IT scenario or fitted scale
outputs: p_it_mw, p_fan_mw, p_other_mw, p_evap_aux_mw, p_fac_mw, pue, t_supply_C, evap_water_m3_per_h, cooling_mode
parameters_priors: supply_target_C=25; return_air_C=35 (declared, unused in simulate); evap_effectiveness=0.85; server_deltaT_C=12; dry_air_cp=1006; fan_fraction=0.025; other_fraction=0.035; evap_aux=0.005×spray
parameter_provenance: code priors chosen to leave room for ~1.07 mild-weather PUE after evaporative auxiliaries; not reported Meta facts. 2011 article supports evaporative outside-air / no-chiller class.
notes: Scaffold, not a digital twin. psychrolib used when installed; otherwise Buck + ASHRAE-form enthalpy. PRN1 late-2023/early-2024 permit evidence is not used to change these priors or to add a cooling breakpoint.

what_it_does: For each year, choose one constant IT-power scale so the gray-box annual facility energy equals Meta-reported MWh. This is calibration closure, not electricity prediction.
equations: P_IT_y = E_fac,y^{reported} / sum_t P_fac(weather_t, P_IT=1 MW)
outputs: hourly p_it_mw, p_fac_mw; electricity_mwh_model_closure; it_energy_mwh_fitted; annual_pue_model
training_period: all years 2011-2024 are closed (no electricity holdout)
is_prediction: no — exact annual closure by construction
notes: Never report the ~0 residual as predictive accuracy.

model_name: Conditional water: global log-scale on raw evaporation
what_it_does: Fit one multiplicative scale s on training years with observed withdrawal via geometric mean of W_obs/W_raw. Apply frozen s to all years including holdout.
equations: s = exp(mean log(W_obs/W_raw)); W_hat = s × W_raw; log SSE used for BIC
parameter_provenance: fitted on train years with water (2014-2022)
training_period: through 2022 (years with positive raw and observed water)
selection_rule: BIC vs one-break; require BIC improvement > 2 to prefer one-break. Current selection: global, BIC=-15.38
is_prediction: yes for holdout annual water; in-sample for train
notes: Selected over the one-break alternative. Holdout errors are large and must be reported prominently.

model_name: Conditional water: one-break log-scale (candidate, not selected)
what_it_does: Optional two-scale model with a break year; 3 effective parameters (two scales + break). Not selected on current training data.
equations: s_pre, s_post geometric means on segments; BIC = n log(SSE/n) + 3 log n
selection_rule: BIC; min_segment_years=3; require modest evidence over global
notes: A selected break would still be statistical only, not a physical technology-change claim.

what_it_does: No-intercept nonnegative regression of annual withdrawal on reported facility MWh. Selected by expanding-window one-step MAPE on train.
equations: W = β_E × E_fac; β_E from NNLS
selection_rule: expanding-window one-step MAPE among pre-registered candidates; ties broken by fewer coefficients then name
notes: Current expanding-window train MAPE 34.25%; holdout MAPE 100.11%. Frozen coefficients; holdout mutation invariance check PASS.

what_it_does: No-intercept nonnegative regression of annual withdrawal on ensemble-median raw evaporation.
parameters_priors: β_v = 5.847440762862596 in current diagnostics (not used for selected predictions)
selection_rule: same expanding-window MAPE; score 45.47% (worse than energy_null)
notes: Not selected. Do not present as the pipeline's water forecast.

model_name: Annual water candidate: nonnegative energy + evaporation
what_it_does: NNLS on E_fac and raw evaporation. Current fit zeros the evaporation coefficient, collapsing to energy_null.
equations: W = β_E E_fac + β_v W_raw; β≥0
parameter_provenance: NNLS on train; not selected (higher rolling MAPE 43.16%)
notes: NNLS dropped evaporation; still not selected because rolling MAPE is worse than the one-coefficient energy model.

what_it_does: Generative scenario: Cox-process arrivals, AR log-intensity, Poisson counts, Gamma work sizes, aggregate queue, utilization→IT shape, annual facility-energy scaling, sampled overhead priors, retrospective water-shape mixture, optional PACW carbon shape. Not recovered telemetry and not a general forecasting model.
equations: latent AR(1) on log-intensity; Poisson arrivals; Gamma compounding; queue recursion; P_IT = scale × shape; E_fac closed annually; water shape = mix(evap, IT, uniform)
inputs: weather coefficients from gray-box unit response; Meta annual electricity/water/Scope 2; optional PACW
parameters_priors: seed 20260812; 32 sims/year; mixed_cox; overhead total ~ N(0.065,0.009) clipped; water-shape evap_share ~ N(0.52,0.10)
parameter_provenance: scenario priors, not identified from traces
training_period: water model train through 2022; electricity/Scope 2 closed every year
is_prediction: only the selected annual water model is a prediction; the rest is scenario/closure
notes: Default carbon allocates annual location Scope 2 in proportion to facility energy unless --use-pacw-shape.

model_name: eGRID NWPP × Meta MWh physical benchmark
what_it_does: Methodology/accounting consistency benchmark: Meta campus MWh times eGRID NWPP output rate versus Meta reported location Scope 2. Not electricity prediction, not a Meta-specific marginal model, and not fully independent external validation (both sides use the same Meta MWh and related inventory geography).
equations: CO2_y = E_y^{Meta} × EF_y^{NWPP} / 2204.6226218487757 lb per t
inputs: meta electricity; eGRID subregion rates; Power Profiler ZIP 97754
notes: Compare to Meta location Scope 2 where disclosed. 2011 eGRID tonnes are labeled eGRID_location_based_accounting_proxy because Meta Scope 2 is not separately disclosed. This is an accounting-method consistency check, not independent campus carbon telemetry. Market/REC not used.

model_name: PACW EIA consumed-CO2 relative hourly shape
what_it_does: Optional relative within-year carbon shape from PACW consumed intensity. Annual Meta location Scope 2 is still closed. Not campus telemetry.
equations: relative shape from CI_consumed; scale so annual tCO2e matches reported location Scope 2
inputs: pacw_hourly.co2_intensity_consumed; Meta annual Scope 2; facility power
selection_rule: prefer EIA consumed intensity when present; else fuel/import proxy
notes: Coverage from 2018-07 for consumed intensity; demand from 2015-07.

what_it_does: Within each month, uses East+West hourly demand only for shape and West monthly NEL/peak/minimum for level. Affine Dhat_W = mean_W + b_m (D_EW - mean_EW), b_m>=0 from peak/min, exact monthly energy closure to NEL_W. EIA-930 is not used to fit. Not reported PACW hourly demand and not campus electricity.
equations: mean_W = NEL_W / H; Dhat_W,t = mean_W + b_m (D_EW,t - mean_EW); sum_month Dhat_W = NEL_W
outputs: pacw_hourly_backcast.csv; optional pacw_demand_hourly_extended.csv (usable EIA reported; FERC proxy only before EIA coverage; adjusted EIA not substituted)
parameter_provenance: FERC West monthly peak and minimum only
holdout_period: 2016-2018 EIA overlap is independent validation; 2015 partial is secondary
selection_rule: single nonnegative monthly scale; no second ML or overlap-calibrated backcast
notes: Does not manufacture consumed CO2, fuel mix, hourly interchange, campus electricity, or marginal emissions. Does not overwrite pacw_hourly.csv.

what_it_does: Named sensitivity proxy only. Not default when EIA consumed intensity exists. Not a Meta-specific MEF.
notes: pacw_carbon_shape_compare.csv records correlation vs EIA intensity where both exist.

what_it_does: Ranks candidate break years by relative SSE reduction of two linear trends vs one, for electricity, water, and water intensity. Statistical candidates only.
equations: SSE of OLS on year; relative reduction = 1 − (SSE_left+SSE_right)/SSE_all; min_seg=3
parameters_priors: min_seg=3; TRAIN_END_YEAR=2022 for the train-only table
holdout_period: exploratory table uses all years and must not be used for holdout model selection
selection_rule: ranking only; not auto-applied to physics epochs
notes: Must not be named as a physical technology change unless independent permit/engineering evidence supports it. Train-only water intensity/water SSE reduction peaks at 2020.

what_it_does: Checks availab = strflow − consum in USGS IWA files. Structural QA, not hydrologic skill.
notes: Never call this independent hydrologic validation.

what_it_does: Aligns modeled monthly campus water proxy with City production and direct POD without using them as calibration targets or summing boundaries.
equations: separate columns; no combined observed campus water
inputs: OWRD processed series; conditional monthly aggregates
notes: Do not compute City vs Meta prediction error. Electricity closure is rechecked as an accounting identity.

what_it_does: Join/coverage diagnostics between CAMPD and EIA-923; cooling-water coverage; unit conversions. Not campus attribution.

parameters_priors: annual comparability envelope 0.85-1.15 documented in QC
notes: Does not infer which generators served Prineville.

what_it_does: Compiles well identities, accepted OWRD pumping groups, GWIS measured water levels, construction/aquifer fields, and hydrogeologic parameter citations. Runs measurement-semantic QC then an identifiability screen on the eligible subset (within-well head_anomaly_ft = -(BLS − mean BLS) vs pumping at exploratory lags 0/1/3/6 months). Does not estimate heads, conductance, storage, or hydraulic connectivity.
equations: none; identity-preserving remapping of accepted OWRD groups; GWIS observation unique key = gw_measured_water_level_id
inputs: city_water_sources; OWRD crosswalks; municipal HUC12 crosswalk; OWRD monthly use; Meta annual water; local GWIS exports; local permit PDF scan
parameter_provenance: GWIS well-log construction/aquifer as reported; secondary 260 MG/y ASR application citation; T/S/Sy unresolved
notes: Feasibility class is recomputed from GWIS+pumping evidence (not hard-coded). Identifiability_conclusion (A-small-subsystem-possible / B-validation-only / C-not-identifiable) is appended by the audit and may differ from broad Class B. ESTIMATION_CANDIDATE means sufficient data to attempt a validated empirical response model, not identified dynamics. HUC12 is not an aquifer node. No reduced-order model is fitted.

what_it_does: Generation-weighted withdrawal/consumption intensity over cooling-intensity-eligible plant-months with non-missing water. Optional regional-average indirect-water proxy = EWIF × Meta MWh.
equations: EWIF = Σ W / Σ G over eligible non-missing plant-months; missing W ≠ 0
selection_rule: cooling_intensity_eligible and generation_mwh>0 and water not missing
notes: Not Meta generator attribution. scientifically_meaningful_grid_ewif is false by construction.

what_it_does: Validates curated documentary seeds, verifies raw PDF SHA-256 when files exist, and writes identity/event/evidence tables. Does not OCR PDFs and does not retune electricity/water models.
